C0792.title: Keenadu Firmware Backdoor Infects Android Tablets via Signed OTA Updates
C0792.summary: A Keenadu firmware backdoor infected Android tablets through signed over-the-air updates, enabling attackers to leverage a supply chain compromise to implant a backdoor at the firmware level for remote control, ad fraud, and data theft, impacting 13,715 devices.
